subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Estabelecer relações entre partes do texto, identificando o antecedente de um pronome relativo ou o referente comum de uma cadeia de substituições lexicais.

components.description_pt: Identificar o nome ou sintagma nominal que um pronome relativo refere
components.description_en: Identify the antecedent noun or noun phrase that a relative pronoun refers to
components.cc_component_description: Determine the intended antecedent of a vague pronoun in context

components.description_pt: Reconhecer cadeias de substituição lexical que compartilham um referente comum no texto
components.description_en: Recognize lexical substitution chains that share a common referent within a text

components.description_pt: Estabelecer relações coesivas entre partes do texto através de referência pronominal e lexical
components.description_en: Establish cohesive relationships between text parts through pronoun and lexical reference
components.cc_component_description: Use appropriate transitions to clarify relationships between ideas in an explanatory text

cc_matches.description: Recognize and correct vague pronouns (i.e., ones with unclear or ambiguous antecedents).
Write informative/explanatory texts to examine a topic and convey ideas, concepts, and information through the selection, organization, and analysis of relevant content
